honest_c3: C1 mac CPU fp32 — single forward path; no GPU sampling variance.

C2 cosine NN bypasses lm_head — different from train-time inference. Train-time decode = lm_head(hidden) softmax argmax; NN cosine = argmax cos(hidden, vocab_emb[i]). These coincide ONLY if lm_head weight ≈ vocab_emb (tied embeddings) AND no scale/bias shift; general case differs.
C3 single prompt '안녕' (1 KO greeting). 1-prompt result cannot generalize to coherent dialogue capability; at most this is a single-trace existence check for semantic content survival to ln_f.

C4 hidden vs vocab dim mismatch handling falls back to lm_head.weight; if lm_head is also dim-mismatched (separate projection / tied via linear), NN runs against a non-vocab embedding space and decoded tokens have NO direct vocab-token semantics — purely substrate geometry, not interpretable text.

C5 'is_semi_coherent' heuristic is anima-internal — Korean/ASCII char count >= 5 + max-char-frequency <= 50%. Not validated against human-judgment coherence; a string of distinct random tokens may PASS while being semantically meaningless.
